name: loom-workspace
description: Loom-managed workspace with AI development orchestration

scripts.check:ci: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run check:signoff-pins && ./.loom/scripts/check-xschem-embedded-quotes.sh
scripts.check:signoff-pins: python3 scripts/ci/check_signoff_pins.py && python3 scripts/ci/check_artifact_manifests.py && python3 scripts/ci/attest_inventories.py && python3 scripts/ci/design_netlists.py --check-lock
scripts.test: npm run test:compile && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:compile: PY="$(scripts/ci/py311.sh --print)" && find sim layout scripts -name '*.py' -not -path 'layout/.venv/*' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 "$PY" -m py_compile
scripts.test:unit: PY="$(scripts/ci/py311.sh --print)" && "$PY" -m unittest discover --start-directory layout/tests --pattern 'test_*.py' && "$PY" -m unittest discover --start-directory sim/tests --pattern 'test_*.py' && "$PY" -m unittest discover --start-directory scripts/ci/tests --pattern 'test_*.py'
scripts.lint: find sim layout scripts signoff design spec -name '*.json' -not -path 'layout/.venv/*' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 python3 -m json.tool > /dev/null && python3 -m json.tool reuse.lock.json > /dev/null && find sim layout scripts signoff -name '*.sh' -not -path 'layout/.venv/*' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 bash -n && bash -n loom.sh && ./.loom/scripts/check-dr-duplicate-numbers.sh
